positive_findings: Shared SHOW_STRATEGY_RECOMMENDATIONS flag hides recommendation tables.
No tested strategy demonstrated a meaningful benchmark-relative edge; rejected results are preserved.
Options display queries open the SQLite database read-only and do not fabricate implied volatility.
Several pages disclose coverage, estimation and timing limitations.
Causal shifts, the Status/Lab separation and reusable UI/provider components are constructive design elements.
material_risks: Present-day NIFTY 500 membership is used and cannot support historical population claims.
Survivorship, stable identity, corporate-action continuity and terminal outcomes are not qualified.
Direct execution controls sit outside the governed gateway; hidden live scans still compute and the recommendation flag is mutable.
Yahoo, Kite and CSV histories are not historically qualified; provenance, adjustment, corrections and revision vintages are incomplete.
The approximately 45 GB F&O database is unqualified for provenance, coverage, corrections, retention and research use.
Transcript, ownership, insider, ratings, AUM and index-reconstitution timing need point-in-time qualification.
Claims such as passed validation, point-in-time, historical universe and heldout require canonical re-evaluation.
The version2.0 Kite path persists credentials/tokens and conflicts with custom_terminal memory-only controls.
Broker substitution is currently disabled, but live order-capable code exists and must remain isolated.
canonical_authority_retained: split access and exact one-use run approval
